title: Hand-drawn sighting area map near Mexicali showing canals, highway and Cerro Prieto
description: Pencil sketch map on lined notebook paper showing roads and waterways near Mexicali. Handwritten labels include "Mexicali City", a highway, a canal with a concrete bridge, an outlined area marked "Cerro Prieto", several "Ejido" plots, and a note reading roughly "15 miles from Mexicali approximately". Arrows trace a travel route along the canal and roads, apparently to locate the reported sighting.
